notes: Profile: mid-sized helpdesk platform; customers are SMBs + distributed retailers.
Primary ask: automated ticket + email summarization for agent UI (one-line summary + key actions).
Secondary ask: multi-label auto-tagging (product, intent, urgency) to drive macros and routing rules in Zendesk/Freshdesk.
Traffic pattern: big spikes during promo weekends (20x baseline), needs graceful degradation and fast fallback path.
Quote from CTO: 'If you can prove sub-300ms suggestion latency for agent assist at 99th percentile, we'll replace our bespoke service.',
Security: must support SSO, customer-managed KMS for attachments, retention controls and exportable audit logs.
Integration: wants a Redwood-hosted edge for low-latency routing but VPC connection for PII extraction steps; prefers model pinning for canary rollouts.
POC scope agreed: 2-week sandbox on staging Zendesk, 10k tickets uplift, measure tagging precision + false positive rate by label.
Commercial note: leaning toward reserved capacity if latency/SLOs validated; price sensitivity around cost per 1k summaries.
Internal champions: Head of Product (Amy Liu), Support Ops lead (Rafael Mendez).

requirements_summary: Workload types: short ticket summarization (1-3 sentences), agent-facing action items, multi-label auto-tagging, macro selection hints.
Latency targets: interactive suggestions <300ms p50, <900ms p95 for agent assist; background summarization can be async (few seconds).
Throughput: baseline 120 reqs/sec, promo peaks 2400 reqs/sec for 1-3 hour windows; must avoid request loss during peaks.
Cost sensitivity: target cost per 1k summaries <$10 (budget constraint for SMB-heavy customer base).
Model preferences: high-quality conversational summarization model; open-model acceptance if quantized for cost efficiency; ability to pin/fallback to smaller model for burst handling.
Routing/fallback: prefer automatic fallback to distilled model or cached-summary on overload; require predictable degradation strategy and telemetry.
Integrations: Zendesk app + Freshdesk webhooks, macros population, ticket field writes, attachments handling (OCR optional).
Compliance: data residency options for EU customers, must provide exportable audit logs and retention policies per tenant.
Observability: want per-route token costs, latency heatmaps, and per-customer error rates; alerting on tag-drift/regression.
